purpose: Preserve deterministic point-in-time SEC XBRL observations as machine truth. Human-selected financial metrics are convenience projections only; the learner retains access to the complete eligible standard-taxonomy fact set.

authority.primary: SEC EDGAR XBRL Company Facts API
authority.customTaxonomyPolicy: Company Facts exposes standard taxonomy facts only. Extension-only disclosures remain absent/unknown rather than inferred.

pointInTime.rule: A fact is eligible only when its SEC filed date is available by the requested asOf cutoff.
pointInTime.note: Company Facts exposes filing date rather than precise acceptance timestamp for each fact; eligibility is delayed until UTC filing-date end to avoid same-day leakage.

rawTruth.truthIdentity: CIK + eligible raw facts hash only; ticker, entity name, retrieval metadata and normalized projections cannot change fact-state truth.

normalizedProjection.purpose: Mechanical convenience view for audit and later outcome calculations; never the only feature space available to learning.

amendmentPolicy.currentVersion: latest eligible filed/accession for the same economic context
amendmentPolicy.note: Later comparative filings may supersede the same economic fact while original versions remain visible.

governance.promotionRequires: separate audit and explicit governance change

storagePolicy.rawObjects: content-addressed by factStateHash and written immutably
storagePolicy.trialSnapshots: small manifests reference existing factStateHash values
storagePolicy.normalizedProjection: recomputable/non-authoritative; never required to duplicate raw truth per tick
storagePolicy.scaleRule: T1000 integration must reference content-addressed truth objects rather than write 250 full Company Facts histories on every tick
